eyebrow.zh: 华为云 · 国际产品简介

subtitle.zh: 面向全球研发团队的 AI 软件交付助手：从意图到可合并变更，缩短交付路径。
subtitle.en: An AI software-delivery assistant for global engineering teams—from intent to merge-ready change, with less friction in the SDLC.

notes.zh: 开场强调国际买家语境：研发效能、工具链协同、企业可控，不谈未核实的价格与 SLA。
notes.en: Open on overseas buyer context: engineering productivity, toolchain fit, and enterprise control—no unverified price or SLA claims.

subtitle.zh: 用可验证的交付结果说话；具体区域合规与容量请以正式材料为准。
subtitle.en: Speak in verifiable delivery outcomes; treat region-specific compliance and capacity as confirm-with-marketing.

notes.zh: 三张卡片分别对应速度、在岗体验、治理姿态；避免承诺具体加速百分比。
notes.en: Three cards map to speed, in-flow experience, and governance posture; avoid inventing acceleration percentages.

body.zh: 在需求澄清、实现与评审环节提供 AI 辅助，帮助团队更快形成可审查、可合并的变更。
body.en: Assist clarification, implementation, and review so teams reach inspectable, merge-ready changes with less thrash.

body.zh: 围绕编码、评审与文档协同提供协助，减少在工具之间来回切换造成的上下文丢失。
body.en: Support coding, review, and documentation collaboration—reducing context loss from constant tool-switching.

body.zh: 按组织工作流与可控边界设计（权限、审计与团队协作约定以正式方案与部署区域为准）。
body.en: Designed around organizational workflows and controllable boundaries (permissions, auditability, and team conventions—confirm per formal proposal and deployment region).

subtitle.zh: 一条可讲解的协作闭环；具体集成清单以 PoC 范围为准。
subtitle.en: A presentable collaboration loop; treat concrete integrations as PoC-scoped.

notes.zh: 演示时按四步走：理解 → 规划 → 生成精炼 → 评审交接；不要展开内部模型细节。
notes.en: Walk four beats: understand → plan → generate & refine → review & handoff; avoid internal model detail.

body.zh: 把业务目标与约束转成可执行的研发任务描述。
body.en: Turn business goals and constraints into actionable engineering task framing.

body.zh: 形成步骤化方案，明确改动面与验收关注点。
body.en: Produce a step-wise plan with change surface and acceptance focus.

body.zh: 辅助实现与迭代，保持人类在环审查。
body.en: Assist implementation and iteration while keeping humans in the review loop.

body.zh: 沉淀可审查结果，进入团队既有合并与发布流程。
body.en: Land reviewable outcomes into the team’s existing merge and release process.

result.zh: 结果：一条可对外讲解的 AI 辅助交付闭环——不替代研发责任，强化交付节奏。
result.en: Outcome: a briefable AI-assisted delivery loop—augmenting engineers, not replacing ownership.

vision.zh:
把数字世界带入每个人、每个家庭、
每个组织，构建万物互联的智能世界。
vision.en:
Bring digital to every person, home and organization
for a fully connected, intelligent world.

notes.zh: 收尾邀请下一步：发现会 / PoC 范围确认；价格与 SLA 不在本页承诺。
notes.en: Close with next step: discovery workshop or PoC scope confirmation—no price or SLA commitments on this slide.
